Word timings from faster-whisper medium on short windows. The streamer's chat/poll window (usernames) is blurred in cuts D and J; the Windows taskbar at source y>1060 is outside the game crop. CUT: a game-character name at h4 21:12 and the swears around h4 21:41. No guns, gore or revealing outfits in frame. Main 48.45 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first).
